The authenticity score of 2.5 reflects the combination of cloning artifacts in cars, semantic attribute failure (elephants), and ground plane issues. This is appropriate given multiple moderate-severity defects rather than one catastrophic failure.

7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides were made. All positive verdicts (is_present=true, attribute=yes) were independently verified through visual inspection of textures, shapes, and spatial relationships.
